title: Pac Production — claimed by thegentlemen
description: SE · Other · pac.se PAC Group is a Swedish power plant automation company founded in 1979 in Stockholm, delivering control systems, simulation and optimization solutions for thermal, hydro, nuclear and renewable power plants. It has completed over 600 projects on more than 100 power plants across 50 countries with a combined capacity exceeding 110 gigawatts. Its product portfolio includes PAC Control, PAC-Sim
